training_data: Project-generated mono/stereo decaying diffuse tails, early reflections and independent noise. No measured IR, external recording or pretrained model.
network: 8 inputs, 24 tanh units, sigmoid output mapped to [0.05,1]
runtime: Offline NumPy only. Separate reviewed float32 WAV export; no convolution audio-thread inference, automatic replacement, resampling, trimming, delay or normalization.
model_identity: Caller supplies expected raw-byte SHA-256; malformed/missing model retains original f32 samples.
quality_gate: Unprotected model failed. Local-budget policy passes a fresh synthetic probe; measured-reference added-noise gains are small and conditional decay changes reach 2.411 dB. Full measured-preservation and ML-adoption gates remain open.
remaining: Independent clean/repeated physical IR/noise acquisitions and explicit weak-decay preservation criteria; the six-room added-noise probe retains recording artifacts and does not identify unknown clean IRs.
Measured layouts/rates beyond the six paired 48 kHz AIR responses, actual true-stereo paths, imperfect prefix identification, listening and application review/import.
Resolve legacy AIR archive redistribution terms before distributing source/derived audio; only hashes, source code, metadata and metrics are committed.

preservation_policy.selection: 60 new development cases; separate policy selection for learned/Wiener/decay, before new final/shift generation. Original model weights unchanged.
preservation_policy.guarantee: Removed energy per short channel/window bounded against stationary prefix-derived noise budget. This does not identify or guarantee the unknown clean IR.

measured_reference_probe.reference: Paired recorded AIR channels cast to float32, with artificial 80 ms zero prefix; original recording noise/artifacts remain in target. Added white/colored noise, not acquisition-noise ground truth. No training or source audio redistribution.
